subject: literacy
concept: Comparing two persuasive texts arguing opposite sides of the same issue
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts arguments from two opposing passages into a two-column comparison chart
exercise.pictorial: Student matches each side's strongest point to its supporting evidence
exercise.abstract: Student writes 2-3 sentences comparing the strength of each side's argument

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies at least one real strength and one real weakness across the two arguments
misconception_flags: simply agrees with whichever side was presented last, without evaluating the arguments

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
